title: Woman Jumps in a Stranger’s Car To Avoid Arrest
description:
An officer was following a female who had an active felony warrant when she unexpectedly jumped into a stranger’s car to avoid him. According to the report, the female had pulled a similar stunt the earlier night with the same officer assisting that time but she didn't know they can only be fooled once. Soon, a supervisor and the medics reached the scene to resuscitate the poor female. After the medics confirmed that the female’s vitals were optimum, the supervisor insisted on taking a stern approach. The 30 year old female was charged with resisting arrest and escape from community custody.
